product_summary: All-in-one newsletter platform for publishing, growth and monetization, including a newsletter ad network, Boosts/Recommendations network, paid subscriptions, podcasts, websites and a public API for publication management.
current_data_sources: First-party publication, subscriber and engagement data from its own platform (open rate, click rate, active subscriptions via API)
Ad Network impression, click and payout performance
Advertiser campaign delivery and engagement reporting
Publisher-declared categories and publication descriptions used for ad targeting

api_or_integration_evidence.quote: Retrieve all publications associated with your API key.
Trigger actions, manage subscribers, and update newsletter data automatically - no manual interaction required.
Using our SSP (Supply-Side Platform) technology, we optimize placement and ensure every ad opportunity is valuable.

newsletter_capability_detail: beehiiv holds the richest first-party newsletter data in the category, but scoped to its own platform: the API only lets you "Retrieve all publications associated with your API key", and its advertiser page sells access to "Thousands of vetted newsletters" inside beehiiv. Their own scale claims: "135K+ publishers on beehiiv growing their content" and "400M+ unique readers every month on beehiiv".
verified_gap: No cross-platform discovery. Their documented API surface returns only publications tied to the caller's own API key, and Ad Network inventory is beehiiv-hosted publications only; nothing documents coverage of Substack, LinkedIn, Ghost or Mailchimp newsletters. Coverage of the open newsletter web sits outside their platform boundary.

evidence.quote: The all-in-one platform helping the world's best newsletters publish, grow and earn.
Retrieve all publications associated with your API key.
Our algorithm places your ads in the newsletters that are most likely to drive your desired business outcomes.
Using our SSP (Supply-Side Platform) technology, we optimize placement and ensure every ad opportunity is valuable.
135K+ publishers on beehiiv growing their content

likely_buyer_role: Head of Ad Network / VP Partnerships or Corporate Development (data or product partnership, not API procurement)

contact_route.note: No public sales/partner email. Support doc states verbatim: "Phone support and a direct email address for support are not currently available." Contact is via in-account ticket or the Knowledge Base chat widget; a partner-team address is referenced on /partners but is redacted in the public page.

caveats: This is a platform partnership, not an API sale: beehiiv builds in-house (own SSP, MCP, API) so the pitch is cross-platform coverage they cannot see - publications on Substack/LinkedIn/Ghost and sponsor mentions outside their network. Note the asymmetry: NF indexes only 1,776 beehiiv publications against beehiiv's stated 135K publishers, so NF adds nothing to beehiiv's internal view of its own base. Also a partial competitor in newsletter ad inventory, which limits willingness to share data.
